component.name: aws2-redshift-data
component.title: AWS RedshiftData
component.description: Run SQL statements and read database metadata in Amazon Redshift through the Amazon Redshift Data API.
component.label: cloud,serverless,database,bigdata

configuration.description: The configuration that the component copies to each endpoint that it creates, so that the endpoints share its values.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

operation.description: The operation that the producer performs. The CamelAwsRedshiftDataOperation header replaces this option.

overrideEndpoint.description: Whether the client sends its requests to the URI of uriEndpointOverride instead of the endpoint of the AWS region. Without uriEndpointOverride this option has no effect.

pojoRequest.description: Whether the message body is the request of the AWS SDK for the operation, such as an ExecuteStatementRequest for executeStatement, which the producer sends as it is. If true, the headers are not used and a body of another type fails the exchange.

profileCredentialsName.description: The name of the profile that the client loads when useProfileCredentialsProvider is true. If not set, the AWS SDK uses the profile that the AWS_PROFILE environment variable or the aws.profile system property names, or else the profile named default.

region.description: The AWS region of the Redshift Data API, as a lowercase region ID such as eu-west-1, which is the value of Region.EU_WEST_1.id(). If not set, the AWS SDK takes the region from its default region provider chain, such as the aws.region system property or the AWS_REGION environment variable.

trustAllCertificates.description: Whether the HTTP client trusts all TLS certificates without validating them. It applies to every connection of the client, also when the endpoint is not overridden.

uriEndpointOverride.description: The URI that the client sends its requests to, for example http://localhost:4566 for a local emulator. It is used only when overrideEndpoint is true.

useDefaultCredentialsProvider.description: Whether the client loads the credentials with the default credentials provider chain of the AWS SDK, which looks in system properties, environment variables, the profile files, and the container and instance metadata. It takes precedence over the other credentials options.

useProfileCredentialsProvider.description: Whether the client loads the credentials from a profile of the AWS config and credentials files, the one that profileCredentialsName names. It takes precedence over useSessionCredentials, accessKey and secretKey, but not over useDefaultCredentialsProvider.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

awsRedshiftDataClient.label: advanced
awsRedshiftDataClient.description: To use a custom software.amazon.awssdk.services.redshiftdata.RedshiftDataClient. When this option is set or autowired, the endpoint does not build a client of its own, so the credentials, region, proxy and endpoint override options are not used. The endpoint does not close a client that is set or autowired.

healthCheckConsumerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckConsumerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all consumer based health checks from this component

healthCheckProducerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckProducerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all producer based health checks from this component. Notice: Camel has by default disabled all producer based health-checks. You can turn on producer checks globally by setting camel.health.producersEnabled=true.

proxyHost.label: proxy
proxyHost.description: The host name of the proxy that the client sends its requests through. The proxy is used only when proxyPort is set as well.

proxyPort.label: proxy
proxyPort.description: The port of the proxy that the client sends its requests through. The proxy is used only when proxyHost is set as well.

proxyProtocol.label: proxy
proxyProtocol.description: The protocol that the client uses to connect to the proxy. It is used only when proxyHost and proxyPort are set.

accessKey.label: security
accessKey.description: The access key ID of the AWS credentials. The client uses it with secretKey as static credentials, or with secretKey and sessionToken when useSessionCredentials is true.

secretKey.label: security
secretKey.description: The secret access key of the AWS credentials, which the client uses together with accessKey.

sessionToken.label: security
sessionToken.description: The session token of temporary AWS credentials, for example from assuming an IAM role. The client uses it only when useSessionCredentials is true, together with accessKey and secretKey.

useSessionCredentials.label: security
useSessionCredentials.description: Whether the client uses temporary session credentials made of accessKey, secretKey and sessionToken, for example after assuming an IAM role. If sessionToken is not set, the client uses accessKey and secretKey as static credentials.

CamelAwsRedshiftDataOperation.description: The operation to perform. It replaces the operation option.

CamelAwsRedshiftDataClusterIdentifier.description: The identifier of the provisioned cluster to connect to. Amazon Redshift requires it for a cluster with AWS Secrets Manager or temporary credentials. Not used by listStatements, cancelStatement, describeStatement and getStatementResult.

CamelAwsRedshiftDataSecretArn.description: The name or ARN of the secret in AWS Secrets Manager that holds the user name and password of the database. Amazon Redshift requires it when it authenticates with AWS Secrets Manager. Not used by listStatements, cancelStatement, describeStatement and getStatementResult.

CamelAwsRedshiftDataDatabase.description: The name of the database. For listSchemas, listTables and describeTable it is the database that holds the schemas or tables, and also the database to connect to when CamelAwsRedshiftDataConnectedDatabase is not set. Not used by listStatements, cancelStatement, describeStatement and getStatementResult.

CamelAwsRedshiftDataWorkGroupName.description: The name or ARN of the Amazon Redshift Serverless workgroup to connect to. Amazon Redshift requires it for a workgroup with AWS Secrets Manager or temporary credentials. Not used by listStatements, cancelStatement, describeStatement and getStatementResult.

CamelAwsRedshiftDataDatabasesMaxResults.description: The maximum number of databases that listDatabases returns. The producer returns only the first page of the response.

CamelAwsRedshiftDataDbUser.description: The database user name. Amazon Redshift requires it to connect to a cluster as a database user with temporary credentials. Not used by listStatements, cancelStatement, describeStatement and getStatementResult.

CamelAwsRedshiftDataConnectedDatabase.description: The database to connect to with the credentials, when it is not the database in CamelAwsRedshiftDataDatabase. Used by listSchemas, listTables and describeTable.

CamelAwsRedshiftDataSchemaPattern.description: A pattern of schema names for listSchemas and listTables, in which % matches any number of characters and _ matches one character. If not set, all schemas match.

CamelAwsRedshiftDataSchemasMaxResults.description: The maximum number of schemas that listSchemas returns. The producer returns only the first page of the response.

CamelAwsRedshiftDataStatementsMaxResults.description: The maximum number of SQL statements that listStatements returns, at most 100. The producer returns only the first page of the response.

CamelAwsRedshiftDataStatementName.description: The name of the SQL statement. executeStatement and batchExecuteStatement give the statement this name, and listStatements returns the statements whose name starts with this value, which is case-sensitive.

CamelAwsRedshiftDataStatus.description: The status of the statements that listStatements returns: SUBMITTED, PICKED, STARTED, FINISHED, ABORTED, FAILED or ALL. If not set, Amazon Redshift returns only the finished statements.

CamelAwsRedshiftDataRoleLevel.description: Whether listStatements returns all statements that the IAM role of the caller ran (true), or only those of the current IAM session (false). If not set, Amazon Redshift uses true.

CamelAwsRedshiftDataTablesMaxResults.description: The maximum number of tables that listTables returns, at most 1000. The producer returns only the first page of the response.

CamelAwsRedshiftDataTablePattern.description: A pattern of table names for listTables, in which % matches any number of characters and _ matches one character. If not set, all tables match.

CamelAwsRedshiftDataTable.description: The name of the table that describeTable describes. If not set, describeTable describes all tables of the matching schemas.

CamelAwsRedshiftDataSchema.description: The schema of the table that describeTable describes. If not set, the tables of all schemas match.

CamelAwsRedshiftDataDescribeTableMaxResu.description: The maximum number of columns that describeTable returns, at most 1000. The producer returns only the first page of the response.

CamelAwsRedshiftDataStatementId.description: The ID of the SQL statement for cancelStatement, describeStatement and getStatementResult, as the response of executeStatement or batchExecuteStatement returns it. For the result of one statement of a batch, add its number as a suffix, for example :2 for the second.

CamelAwsRedshiftDataWithEvent.description: Whether Amazon Redshift sends an event to the Amazon EventBridge event bus after the SQL statements run. Used by executeStatement and batchExecuteStatement.

CamelAwsRedshiftDataClientToken.description: A unique, case-sensitive identifier of at most 64 characters, which makes a retried request idempotent. Used by executeStatement and batchExecuteStatement.

CamelAwsRedshiftDataSqlStatement.description: The SQL statement that executeStatement runs, which must be a single statement. The producer does not wait for the statement to finish: describeStatement and getStatementResult take the ID that the response returns.

CamelAwsRedshiftDataSqlParameterList.description: The parameters of the SQL statement of executeStatement, as a java.util.List of software.amazon.awssdk.services.redshiftdata.model.SqlParameter, each with a name and a value. The statement refers to a parameter as :name.

CamelAwsRedshiftDataSqlStatementList.description: The SQL statements that batchExecuteStatement runs, as a java.util.List of String with at most 40 statements. They run one after the other in a single transaction, which is rolled back if one of them fails.

producerIn.description: Not used: the operations take their input from headers, such as the SQL of executeStatement in CamelAwsRedshiftDataSqlStatement; SQL in the body is not run. With pojoRequest=true the request of the AWS SDK for the operation, such as an ExecuteStatementRequest: another body fails

producerOut.description: The response of the AWS SDK for the operation, such as the ExecuteStatementResponse of executeStatement, which does not wait for the statement, or the GetStatementResultResponse of getStatementResult with one page of records
